“You’ll have to go to the walk-in in Faversham or Sheppey.”

That’s 15+ miles away. No thought given to whether you’ve got transport, other kids to care for, or even the ability to drop everything and travel. Just a blanket refusal to help.

This isn’t just poor service – it’s a total collapse in basic NHS care. They are not functioning as a GP surgery. There’s no duty of care, no continuity, and no accountability. They are simply gatekeeping access and pushing people elsewhere.

As a parent, it’s terrifying to know your children won’t be seen when they’re ill. You’re on your own.

This practice is failing its patients day in, day out. If you’re thinking of signing up here – don’t. Go elsewhere.
